items.title: Pullback along a composition is the composition of pullbacks by adjoint uniqueness
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sheaves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 5 行、拉回复合：f_p ⊣ f_*、g_p ⊣ g_*，推前复合引理给公共右伴随 (g∘f)_* = g_*∘f_*；伴随唯一性（相差唯一同构）给出 (g∘f)_p ≅ f_p∘g_p。承重两步（公共右伴随、伴随唯一性）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pullback-composition (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2425-2432

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: both (g composition f)_p and f_p composed with g_p are left adjoints to the pushforward (g composition f)_* = g_* composed with f_*, and left adjoints are unique up to unique isomorphism (source lines 2434-2438)
